Enum Class MaterialType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MaterialType>
net.murat.material.MaterialType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MaterialType>, Constable
public enum MaterialType extends Enum<MaterialType>
Enum defining the primary material categories. Each type has default parameter presets for the material generator. Used for UI templates and quick material creation.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    CARPET
    Carpet/fabric material - soft, matte, patterned Default: zero reflectivity, high roughness, checkerboard pattern
    CUSTOM
    Custom user-defined material All parameters must be explicitly set by the user
    FABRIC
    Fabric/cloth material - very matte, no specular Default: zero reflectivity, maximum roughness
    GLASS
    Glass/transparent material - refractive, partially reflective Default: high transparency, IOR ~1.5, Fresnel effect enabled
    LEATHER
    Leather material - matte, slightly rough, soft appearance Default: low reflectivity, moderate roughness
    MARBLE
    Marble material - veined patterns, polished finish Default: marble pattern, moderate reflectivity, low roughness
    METAL
    Metallic material - highly reflective, conductive appearance Default: high reflectivity, low roughness, strong Fresnel effect
    PLASTIC
    Standard plastic material - matte to glossy finish Default: moderate reflectivity, no transparency, medium shininess
    RUBBER
    Rubber material - very matte, soft, non-reflective Default: zero reflectivity, high roughness, no specular
    SNOW_GLOBE
    Snow globe style - vertical gradient (white top, green bottom) Default: matte, rough, gradient pattern
    WOOD
    Wood material - ring patterns, moderate reflectivity Default: wood ring pattern, semi-gloss finish
